decisions.statement: M99 is the Single Source of Truth for canonical identity and verified knowledge.
Knowledge First: verified knowledge precedes content, publishing and downstream automation.
AI Native, not AI Invented: AI must not invent technical or commercial facts.
Before new architecture proposals, consult Decision Registry, Current Context, Project State, latest README, relevant ADR and tests/history.
A failed implementation attempt does not reopen a DECIDED rule.
README remains the master human-readable constitution and machine-readable governance files are mandatory project memory.
No Duplicate Data: reusable canonical facts/entities are stored once and mapped, not duplicated per channel.
Historical observations are preserved.
Market and Channel are separate concepts.
Removing a product from a channel must not destroy accumulated M99 knowledge.
Important facts preserve provenance including source, observation/verification time and conflict/reviewer context where available.
Evidence priority is exact manufacturer, official documentation/certificates, validated B2B, exact supplier, verified internal data, operator, then AI over verified data.
Observation is evidence and does not automatically become canonical truth.
Operator-first UX.
One-decision-per-screen is the target operator UX.
Operators must not need Python, PowerShell, API, HTTP, JSON, XML, SQL, credentials or platform internals.
The primary operator workflow is generalized Add Products, not a dedicated Add to m99.eu screen.
Primary Supplier selection UX must not require URL copy/paste or BAT/Python scripts.
M99 canonical identity is independent from external IDs.
Historical rule: M99- followed by digits only. Superseded for new allocations by ID-006; retained only for compatibility/history.
decisions.statement_historical: M99 Reference format is M99- followed by digits only.

decisions.statement: Assigned M99 identity is never reused for another ProductGroup.
Identity Before Content.
Identity resolution states are NEW, EXISTING, AMBIGUOUS and UNRESOLVED; AMBIGUOUS requires human decision.
ProductGroup lifecycle is draft -> active -> paused -> retired.
Hard DELETE requires explicit human approval and typed DELETE confirmation.
Supplier and Manufacturer are Organization roles; one Organization may hold both roles.
New Supplier, Manufacturer and Brand proposals require Super Admin approval before general operator availability.
A canonical product may have multiple verified supplier/manufacturer mappings.
Brand is a separate canonical object linked to owner/manufacturer organizations and official sources.
B2B portals belong to Organizations and declare connector capabilities.
An Organization may have multiple SupplierSources such as public website, B2B, API, feeds, catalogues, price lists and stock feeds.
SupplierSources declare explicit capabilities including identity, technical facts, images, price, availability, variants and stock where supported.
The running M99 runtime may use controlled read-only live SupplierSource access; SAFE installers do not crawl suppliers automatically.
Supplier-specific adapters implement one common Live Supplier Connector contract so the operator UI remains supplier-independent.
Direct Supplier Selection is the target UX.
Selection supports one or many products, one or many categories, and all products where the source supports it.
Every new-product import is an auditable ImportJob.
WRITE_TARGETS = REQUESTED intersect AUTHORIZED intersect READY.
Import presets simplify workflows but never grant permissions not already held by the user.
Operators may choose one or more authorized target channels/ERP destinations for NEW PRODUCT IMPORT.
m99.eu is one target channel, not the central Add Product workflow.
NOT_SELECTED and BLOCKED are distinct target states.
New products publish TEST/Draft first.
TEST category is resolved live.
Final category is operator-owned.
CREATE and UPDATE are separate contracts.
Duplicate guard runs before CREATE.
Readback is mandatory after write.
HTTP 200/201 does not equal Product Quality PASS.
Activation requires authorization.
Front Office verification is required where applicable after channel writes.
Content is channel/market/language aware and based on verified facts.
Every required content field is reviewed per language; Image and ALT are reviewed together.
Supplier prose is not copied verbatim; prose/SEO is adapted per channel and language.
Language Registry is dynamic and channel language IDs are discovered live rather than assumed.
Image source priority is official manufacturer, then verified supplier; another M99 channel is not the master image source by default.
Image pipeline is discover -> verify -> download -> relevance -> dedupe -> resize -> WebP -> localized ALT -> operator review -> upload -> readback.
A variational product must have exactly one default combination.
Visible size is not stock.
Dolibarr/M99 stock is variant-aware.
Target selling price is gross VAT-included customer price.
VAT is channel/market configuration and is not a universal hardcoded constant.
Supplier price changes flow through approved pricing rule, currency, VAT, target gross, platform representation, write, readback and Front Office verification.
Existing products sync daily and NO_CHANGE means NO_WRITE.
Daily Existing Product Sync is separate from New Product Import and is not controlled by new-product target selection.
Daily Sync operates on canonical products with verified supplier/source mappings.
Daily Sync checks price, availability, variants/sizes, product changes and discontinuation.
Daily Sync updates only already-existing allowed channel/ERP mappings and never auto-creates a missing channel product.
Daily Sync change states include NO_CHANGE, PRICE_CHANGED, AVAILABILITY_CHANGED, VARIANT_AVAILABILITY_CHANGED, PRODUCT_CHANGED, SUPPLIER_DISCONTINUED and VERIFICATION_FAILED.
VERIFICATION_FAILED is not interpreted as zero stock or OUT_OF_STOCK; last verified observation is preserved.
Daily Sync must expose business metrics including checked products, changes, writes, NO_CHANGE, blocked and errors.
Supplier observations preserve source/product/variant mapping, timestamps, price/currency, availability, changed fields and verification/provenance state.
Historical supplier observations are retained to explain commercial changes over time.
Presence is not Stock.
M99 provides bidirectional Product Presence reporting: Product -> Channels and Channel -> Products, including missing mappings.
Presence states include NOT_PRESENT, PRESENT_DRAFT, PRESENT_TEST, PRESENT_ACTIVE, PRESENT_PAUSED, PRESENT_RETIRED, PRESENT_LAST_VERIFIED, UNKNOWN and VERIFICATION_FAILED.
Product Presence stores external IDs, publication state, price, last verification/sync and errors where available.
M99 owns canonical identity/knowledge; Dolibarr is the operational ERP/CRM/warehouse representation.
M99-owned physical stock increases through supplier reception and decreases through customer shipment.
Dolibarr uses a distinct target adapter/payload and is not treated as another website.
Approved Supplier/Manufacturer Organizations may have linked EXTERNAL availability warehouses in Dolibarr named after the organization.
Warehouse ownership/type distinguishes M99_PHYSICAL, SUPPLIER_EXTERNAL and MANUFACTURER_EXTERNAL.
Supplier/manufacturer external warehouse availability is never interpreted automatically as M99-owned physical stock.
External warehouse availability is variant-aware where reliable source data is variant-level.
Numeric external warehouse quantity is written only when the source provides a reliable exact quantity; status-only availability never receives invented numeric stock.
Supplier availability states may represent exact quantity, in stock, low stock, out of stock, on request, unknown or verification failed without fabricating quantities.
Existing Product Content Revision is a separate operational class from New Product Import and Daily Sync.
Existing approved Product Name and URL/slug are normally locked during content revision.
Existing Category Name, URL/slug and structural identity fields are normally locked during content revision.
Product and Category content may be revised without reopening structural identity by default.
A numeric quality score can never override a failed critical Product Quality Gate.
Operators never see channel/B2B credentials and secrets are never committed to Git, logged or exposed in screenshots.
Permissions are enforced server-side, not only by menu visibility.
Authentication direction includes secure password hashing, session management, timeout, failed-login protection, reset workflow and login/logout audit.
Central Super Admin logs include Audit, System, Supplier/B2B & Channel Integration and Security logs.
Minimum operational log context includes timestamp, severity, user, module, operation, entity, supplier/channel, job_id, result, message and correlation_id.
MoneyWork and legacy sites are reconciliation sources, not canonical masters.
Preferred migration flow is Inspect -> Normalize -> Deduplicate -> Identity Map -> Supplier/Customer Map -> Dry Run -> Import -> Reconcile -> Audit.
CRM foundation flow is First call -> Offer -> Second call.

Operational classes remain distinct: New Product Import, Existing Product Daily Sync, Manual/Exceptional Repair, Existing Product Content Revision, Existing Category Content Revision and Knowledge/Evidence Acquisition.
SAFE development uses clean baseline, controlled patch, compile, dedicated tests, full regression, exact scope review, explicit COMMIT and no automatic Push.
Normative new M99 Reference format is literal "M99 " followed by exactly six digits. Historical hyphenated references remain compatibility-only and are never newly allocated.
Canonical allocation preserves the historical reserved floor through M99 100017; the first new live canonical allocation is M99 100018 and assigned identities are never reused.
Supplier and Manufacturer remain separate semantic roles even when Supplier Reference and Manufacturer MPN have the same character value.
Durable Manufacturer evidence may be reused across jobs only by exact governed evidence scope (supplier reference + target + exact product URL/checksum context); no fuzzy or brand-wide inference.
Publish-facing content is rebuilt from checksum-verified durable evidence with the current content generator; stale stored prose must not silently bypass the current content gate.
Customer-facing content must not expose internal M99 governance/evidence/debug wording; each channel language must be natural and language-pure.

Benchmark framework: Amazon/Zalando/eBay for hierarchy, scanability, variants, images, specifications and buying information; Apple for clarity, hierarchy, concise benefits and low-noise presentation; exact manufacturer sources for factual truth; Stenso/Palltex and relevant local competitors for market terminology and positioning without copying prose.
Search benchmark is dynamic by country/language/query; there is no permanent hardcoded SEO winner.
For M99 web channels, the target customer GROSS price is lower than the verified benchmark supplier GROSS price by a randomly generated percentage from 1.00% through 1.70%.
The random undercut factor is generated for initial pricing and when a verified supplier benchmark price changes; NO_CHANGE means no price rewrite and no gratuitous re-randomization.

Supplier benchmark price is observed daily from the highest-priority verified commercial source: validated B2B when available, otherwise exact supplier product page. Source/category/search/competitor pages are not accepted as commercial price evidence.

Price change pipeline is SupplierObservation -> verified change detection -> M99 pricing rule -> market currency -> channel VAT -> target GROSS -> platform representation -> write -> API readback -> Front Office gross verification. Out-of-policy anomalies go to NEEDS_REVIEW.
Human by exception, not by repetition: repeatable decisions covered by approved rules are automated; humans handle policy approval, exceptions, conflicts, destructive actions and high-risk anomalies.

Category/multi-product processing must not require product-by-product typed confirmations. Products are machine-classified as AUTO_READY, NEEDS_REVIEW or BLOCKED; batch confirmation applies to the ready set while exceptions are reviewed separately.
Automation is fail-closed: any failed critical gate blocks that product/target without blocking unrelated AUTO_READY items unless the failure is systemic.
Every NEW PRODUCT ImportJob provides explicit multi-select target choice across all configured authorized channels; no channel is silently selected by default.

Current selectable web-channel scope is mela99.com, rabotni-drehi.com, m99.eu, medicinski-drehi.com, laviro.ro, alviro.ro and toplinka.com; Dolibarr is a separate ERP/CRM/warehouse destination when the workflow permits it.
Category publishing uses one generalized engine for one product, many products, one/many categories, first N, only-new-to-M99 or all selected products; no per-product custom code.
Batch quality report must aggregate target readiness, successful writes/readbacks and exception reasons so the operator works on exceptions rather than repetitive confirmations.

First real Palltex canonical CREATE pilot: Product 2041 / M99 100018 on m99.eu, hidden/offline/non-orderable in Test category 26, strict API truth verified. It proves CREATE plumbing but is not production-ready and must not be activated yet.

Product 2041 quality blockers before production acceptance: no product image, no BWOLF channel brand/manufacturer mapping, no real combinations, mixed-language/customer-internal content, weak SEO lengths/slug, and unvalidated 0% tax rule.

rules.GIT-001: Every accepted revision ends with Safe Git Checkpoint.
rules.GIT-002: Use small checkpoints after each accepted coherent milestone.
rules.GIT-003: Runtime, secrets, local-only artifacts never enter Git.
rules.GIT-004: Run maintained regression suites only; historical/live diagnostics are separate.
rules.GIT-005: Documentation travels with accepted code and decisions do not remain only in chat.
rules.GIT-006: Fetch and verify remote parent before push; no force/reset-hard/clean/uncontrolled merge/rebase.
rules.GIT-007: One-click operator workflow; target approval is SAVE M99 CHECKPOINT.
rules.GIT-008: Every master README checkpoint automatically generates and checkpoints MD + machine JSON + Bulgarian DOCX + DOC as one governed artifact set.

git_governance_v16.completion: Functional Acceptance PASS + Maintained Regression PASS + Safe Git Checkpoint PASS + Push PASS + HEAD == origin/main PASS
